headline: Prioritize playback reliability: stop unexpected interruptions and crashes
memo_markdown:
## Recommendation
Prioritize playback. Fix `playback.playback_stops_or_skips` and `playback.crash_freeze` first, focusing on reliable continuous listening and preventing freezes that require a restart.

## Evidence
Playback has 41,943 complaints [A015], mean severity 3.188184 [A017], and 26.54% of area complaints at severity four or above [A021]. Stops or skips account for 19,469 complaints [C013] and severity sum 61,848 [C014]; crashes or freezes have the highest mean severity among the cited issues at 3.613809 [C027]. Playback complaint share fell from 8.11% early [T033] to 4.55% late [T036], so the issue remains substantial but is not worsening in the trend windows. Reviews describe repeated restarts (`d5cf4d6e-34b7-4e12-bf8d-995d4e09503f`) and crashes requiring a hard reboot (`b007bb8d-f5e0-4b61-9575-e03bc1f755aa`).

## Alternatives considered
Billing/support has more complaints, 59,521 [A008], and the top-ranked `billing.premium_paywall` has 49,834 [C001]. Its complaint share rose from 3.92% early [T009] to 13.04% late [T012], making it the strongest alternative. Usability also has more complaints, 82,828 [A001], but a lower mean severity of 2.506640 [A003]. Access has the highest area mean severity, 3.864256 [A038], and 84.81% severity-four-or-above share [A042], but 9,540 complaints [A036]; its share rose from 0.99% early [T003] to 1.83% late [T006].

## Limitations
Evidence covers self-selected public reviews, not a customer population. Cancellation records express intent, not observed churn. Trend windows exclude the partial first and last months. Issue classifications may not capture the underlying cause consistently.
